info.title: Notify JWT service
info.description: Signs requests to the GOV.UK Notify API. The /v2 routes mirror Notify's own and add the JWT, so a caller that can only hold a static credential never has to deal with a token that expires after 30 seconds. POST /token returns a bare token instead, for callers that want to make the onward call themselves.

PrecompiledLetterRequest.title: PrecompiledLetterRequest
PrecompiledLetterRequest.description:
A letter supplied as a ready-made PDF.

Notify accepts this on the same endpoint as a templated letter; it is a
separate operation here so that each has a single, unambiguous schema for
the Azure custom connector.
